transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: I wiped his name off my board this morning. Then I wrote it back. I'm not ready to decide what he is.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Copy the archive before cutting Kiro. If a hidden radar answers, listen to its command channel until we can find it.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: I'd like to know what he saw.

transcript.speaker: RUSK
transcript.text: Declare the emergency first. Find the reason after. In a year, nobody has asked me for the reason.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Kiro's archive survived. We have his signing key. But a key alone is a rumour. We need two more stations' logs with the same signature.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: Lira and Merel sit on opposite ridges and hate each other's weather. Lira lies, Merel repeats her. The west ridge still hears the farms.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Three logs, one signature. If his words go out from the west ridge, they reach the people who hid him.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: The north farm road has beacons the farmers maintain themselves. If another dish wakes up, that is how you reach it.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: His own words, in his own voice, on their own relay. He'd have liked that.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Your packet reached the farms. The old woman heard it in her kitchen. She says Teal sounded tired. She says he always sounded tired.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: A loyalist crew has one mobile transmitter on a flatbed. It's the only voice on the plateau that isn't his. They're driving it into the refugee corridor.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: A transmitter on wheels is harder to silence than a voice in a tower. Harder to protect, too. Somebody will have to fly very close to a very slow truck.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: If the truck hears a different order, stop it at the fork. Check the mill road, test its new link and bring the relief crew in.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Slow truck. Fast jet. I've done worse maths.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: The transmitter is through. Its first reply named four fuel silos and a relay on a 'farm' with a rail siding and no animals.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: They call it a farm because a fuel ledger would show the number of aircraft. The silos with no dust on the ladders. Those are the ones.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: There are real houses in that yard. Families who work the siding. I need you to come home with the right number of fires.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: The rail crew can copy the fuel ledger while you fly. Stay for their handoff. A burning tank cannot testify, but its ledger can.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Four tanks and a dish. I can count to five.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: There's a saddle where all three arrays can hear you at once. Go and say something true there. Nobody's said anything true on that frequency in a long time.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: The staging raid exposed a command frequency. It only reaches the saddle, and the antennas up there are his.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Teal flew that saddle on his checkride. Vulture Two signed the card. I pulled it last night. The handwriting matches the forged orders.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: A truck with a dish can replace a dead antenna. Look along the saddle road before we call the chain silent.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Then I'll fly his checkride for him. Properly, this time.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Three stations, one signature. The mobile crew has it on tape with the real governor's death certificate read over the top. It runs thirty-five seconds.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: A clear signal needs time. Don't give them a hero. Give them thirty-five seconds and a hero is beside the point.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: He recorded that two weeks before he vanished. Thirty-five seconds. He'd already timed it. He knew exactly what this would take.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: When the garrisons answer, follow their beacons and look for parked aircraft. A reply on the radio is not yet a promise kept.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Thirty-five seconds. Nobody jams me for thirty-five seconds.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Three garrisons heard it. Two stood down. And then the Marshal answered.

transcript.speaker: RUSK
transcript.text: Varda Rim has broadcast enemy propaganda. It is a hostile station. The Teklan orchard sheltered the source. There will be no further warnings.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: The orchard burned at noon. The old woman is alive. Her granddaughter is alive. The seed tin is ash. That's my report, and I hate it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: I asked you to broadcast. I'd ask again. I need you to know that I'd ask again.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: Storms ground frightened people. They don't ground orders, or fuel, or the people who own them. When the weather's bad, that's when they move.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Rain hides the last fuel markings. Look first. Then stay to copy the relay's final traffic while the farm crew gets clear.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Then he's moving now, under the weather. And I'm going to be under it with him.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: His plateau fuel is gone. One relay still talks: the crown station, under the aurora. It only transmits at night.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: At the crown station I left the order that started all of this. The first one. With his real signature, before he learned to use dead men's names.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: I didn't take it with me. I didn't trust myself to get home. I trusted the dish.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: He didn't trust himself to get home. He said it out loud, to a tape, and flew anyway. I keep rewinding that part.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: If the archive jams, look under the array. We bring home the whole signature this time, even if we have to receive it twice.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: He trusted the dish. I can do that much.

transcript.speaker: LOG
transcript.text: ARCHIVE RECOVERED. ORDER 0001. 'Declare regional emergency. Suspend parliament. Assume air command.' Signed: RUSK, AIR MARSHAL.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Rusk. He gave the speech at Teal's wing ceremony. He told us the sky belongs to whoever is willing to be up in it.

transcript.speaker: VULTURE TWO
transcript.text: Varda trainee, this is Vulture Two. I taught your instructor to fly. I know what he'd try from that ridge. Turn home. Nobody has to watch.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: Vulture Two taught me that an order is not the same as a duty. Then he forgot. If you meet him, remind him. Loudly.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: He's challenged your call sign from the ridge. Searchlights. He wants you to climb into them. He wants to see your face.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Mark a ridge pickup site before you meet him. If he ejects, the marines need time; the coast needs his testimony after that.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Then he'll see it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Vulture Two is down. He ejected. Marines lifted him off the ridge. He asked if you were Teal's. I said yes.

transcript.speaker: VULTURE TWO
transcript.text: He was the best I ever signed off. Tell the kid the handwriting was mine. All of it. I'm done lying to pilots.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: On the coast, look at what the cranes unload. The uniforms tell you nothing. The crates do.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Three warehouses on the military quays, two blocks from a fish market. Rusk put his war where he knew we'd hesitate.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Workers are still on those quays. Trace their launch a clear lane and stay for the rescue count after the stores burn.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: He's right. I'll hesitate. Then I'll aim.
